set.text: Dear Diary, it's me, Sora. Today was a busy Saturday. I woke up at eight and ate toast with jam. At ten, I met my friend Hana at the park, and we rode our bikes by the river. We had lunch at noon, and then we went to the library to return some books. In the evening I helped my mother make dinner. Before bed, I read a comic book for twenty minutes. I was tired, but I felt happy.

set.text: You can grow beans at home in four easy steps. First, put a bean on wet paper and place it in a clear cup. Second, keep the cup near a window so that it gets light. Third, add a few drops of water every day. After about a week, a small root appears. Then move the bean to a pot with soil. Soon green leaves will grow. Remember, too much water can make the bean rot, so be careful.
